_meta.description: Curated marketplace seed: first-party HoloScript core traits, hand-verified as genuinely implemented (not Pattern-B stubs) before listing. Source of truth: packages/core/src/traits/<Name>Trait.ts. Each record's `export` is the symbol verified importable from '@holoscript/core/traits' (the traits barrel) on main. Freshness pass 2026-07-09: 4 of the original 48 entries dropped (VolumetricClouds, FluidSimulation, Cache, Retry — implemented but not re-exported from the traits barrel, so their import claim no longer holds). Stats (downloads/rating) are honest zeros — these are freshly listed, not fabricated. Seeded by src/seed/seedDatabase.ts.
_meta.author: HoloScript

traits.name: AdvancedPBR
traits.description: Compiles advanced physically-based materials (clearcoat, anisotropy, sheen, subsurface, iridescence, transmission) into Unity, Unreal, Godot, Three.js, and WebGPU shader code.

traits.name: GlobalIllumination
traits.description: Configures and compiles GI systems (SH probes, DDGI, lightmaps, Lumen) to Unity, Unreal, Three.js, and a WebGPU spherical-harmonics evaluation shader.

traits.name: GaussianSplat
traits.description: Runtime 3D Gaussian Splatting with camera-driven resort, octree LOD selection, Gaussian-budget enforcement, and 4D/streaming temporal frame management.

traits.name: SubsurfaceScattering
traits.description: Subsurface-scattering material with skin/wax/jade/marble/leaf presets that compiles to Unity, Unreal, Three.js, and a WebGPU Burley SSS shader.

traits.name: Shader
traits.description: Custom shader authoring with include assembly, GLSL brace/paren validation, uniform management, a preset library, and Three.js ShaderMaterial config generation.

traits.name: Rigidbody
traits.description: Rigidbody physics with force/impulse/velocity/acceleration integration modes, cross-product torque, sleep control, colliders, and collision event dispatch.

traits.name: Buoyancy
traits.description: Liquid buoyancy via Archimedes' principle, computing submersion ratio, net buoyant force, fluid drag, current flow, and velocity-based splash events each frame.

traits.name: VoronoiFracture
traits.description: Procedural destruction with Voronoi-cell fragments, distance-falloff damage, crack propagation across a neighbor graph, distance LOD, and fragment pooling.

traits.name: GranularMaterial
traits.description: Discrete-element granular simulator (sand, gravel) with spatial grid, particle spring/cohesion/friction contact forces, semi-implicit Euler integration, and boundary reflection.

traits.name: Rope
traits.description: Rope/cable trait that initializes Verlet segments, tracks length and tension from physics updates, and triggers breakage events above the configured break force.

traits.name: Networked
traits.description: Multiplayer sync with WebRTC/WebSocket/local transports, an interpolation buffer (lerp/slerp + quaternion extrapolation), ownership transfer, and rate-limited delta sync.

traits.name: CRDTRoom
traits.description: Declarative CRDT room config parser and validator covering sync tiers, interest regions, sharding, presence, and persistence with full per-field validation rules.

traits.name: SharedWorld
traits.description: Synchronized world state with a sync-rate accumulator, object ownership, last-write-wins conflict resolution, late-join full-state sync, and spatial persona layout.

traits.name: NetworkedAvatar
traits.description: Networks avatar skeletal pose by building a humanoid skeleton with IK chains, running the controller, and rate-limited broadcasting/applying of bone transforms.

traits.name: Consensus
traits.description: Distributed consensus wrapping Raft and simple-majority managers with propose, subscribe, leader election, cluster membership, and inter-node message handling.

traits.name: RemotePresence
traits.description: Telepresence trait tracking remote peer avatars with bandwidth-adaptive quality, stale-peer skipping, pose/voice/video state, and per-peer interpolated avatar updates.

traits.name: SpatialVoice
traits.description: WebRTC spatial voice chat managing connected-peer state, voice-activity speaking detection, mute/unmute, and per-frame position emission for spatialization.

traits.name: Ambisonics
traits.description: Higher-order ambisonic playback with decoder init, source-load gating, head-tracked scene rotation updates, runtime order reconfiguration, and gain control.

traits.name: HRTF
traits.description: Binaural HRTF trait that re-emits database/config changes on drift and tracks the listener's headset pose with perceptual position/rotation thresholds to debounce updates.

traits.name: ReverbZone
traits.description: Spatial reverb zone that smoothly blends wet level toward a target based on listener enter/exit and distance-from-edge, emitting reverb mix updates.

traits.name: AudioOcclusion
traits.description: Audio occlusion computing material-aware occlusion from raycast hits, smoothing a frequency-dependent low-pass target, and applying dB-to-gain attenuation.

traits.name: LipSync
traits.description: Real-time lip-sync with FFT band analysis, viseme/phoneme timestamp sampling, IPA/ARPAbet-to-viseme mapping, co-articulation, and ARKit/Oculus blend-shape output.

traits.name: Accessible
traits.description: Provides ARIA-like roles, focus and live-region announcement queueing, and keyboard handling including slider value stepping for spatial nodes.

traits.name: Dialog
traits.description: Branching conversation and modal dialog system managing nodes, choices, and state transitions across a large handler implementation.

traits.name: Grabbable
traits.description: Makes objects grabbable via hand pinch, with two-handed scale and rotation manipulation and throw-velocity calculation on release.

traits.name: Pressable
traits.description: Turns a node into a physical 3D button using a prismatic spring joint with hysteresis press detection and haptic feedback.

traits.name: Scrollable
traits.description: Scroll container with drag tracking, inertial momentum, and spring-based elastic boundary snap-back for content offset.

traits.name: SpatialNavigation
traits.description: World-scale turn-by-turn navigation tracking waypoint progression, distance-to-next math, and arrival detection via player position.

traits.name: LLMAgent
traits.description: LLM decision agent managing conversation history, token-budget trimming, tool-call loops, rate limiting, and escalation conditions.

traits.name: RAGKnowledge
traits.description: Retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that chunks documents with overlap, maps retrieval results to chunks, reranks, and re-indexes.

traits.name: NPCAI
traits.description: Drives NPC dialogue via a real AI adapter chat call, tracks conversation history, and parses response action tags into behavior events.

traits.name: BehaviorTree
traits.description: Full behavior-tree executor with sequence, selector, parallel, decorator, and action nodes, a blackboard, and running-status propagation.

traits.name: Perception
traits.description: Agent sensory system computing sight FOV angle and distance, decaying entity confidence over time, and tracking threat-driven alert level.

traits.name: GoalOriented
traits.description: GOAP planner using A* over world-state nodes with preconditions, effects, a heuristic, and plan reconstruction to reach agent goals.

traits.name: Wallet
traits.description: Crypto wallet connection lifecycle state machine handling connect, chain enforcement, ENS resolution, balance, signing, and account changes.

traits.name: NFT
traits.description: Links a node to NFT ownership, running ownership verification, metadata loading, periodic re-verification, and a transfer flow via events.

traits.name: TokenGated
traits.description: Access control via token holdings with allow/block lists, minimum-balance gating, fallback behaviors, and periodic re-verification.

traits.name: EconomyPrimitives
traits.description: In-scene agent economy with credit accounts, spend limits, escrowed bounty lifecycle, subscriptions, and a per-account transaction ledger.

traits.name: ReputationLedger
traits.description: Per-observer trust scoring ledger with behavior facts, TTL-based pruning, retention-breach alerts, and clamped snapshot aggregation.

traits.name: ResourceAccounting
traits.description: Reconciles expected versus observed quantities in BigInt across ledger domain adapters, emitting deterministic receipts with tolerance-based drift detection.

traits.name: Scheduler
traits.description: Multi-job scheduler firing named jobs by interval with execution counting, repeat/once modes, max-execution removal, and pause/resume.

traits.name: RateLimiter
traits.description: Per-key rate limiting implementing both token-bucket refill and sliding-window timestamp algorithms with allowed/rejected accounting.

traits.name: CircuitBreaker
traits.description: Circuit breaker with closed/open/half-open states, a windowed failure-rate threshold, automatic half-open recovery, and request logging.

traits.name: StructuredLogger
traits.description: Structured log sink with level-priority filtering, count-based rotation, per-level counts, structured fields, and paginated retrieval.
